# Gofo Installs France-First Automated Sorter at Lyon E-Commerce Hub

Gofo equips its relocated Lyon hub with a France-first AI sorter: 6,500 parcels an hour in 870 sqm, live by end 2026 to absorb peak e-commerce volumes.

Gofo, a US-founded, technology-driven last-mile carrier that has become a spearhead for Chinese e-commerce abroad, is expanding its French network ahead of the year-end peak. The centrepiece is its Lyon hub, now moved to a more modern site and about to receive an automated sorting system the company calls a first of its kind in France.

## A denser, smaller sorter

The contrast with Gofo’s other French site tells the story. Its Bonneuil hub, in Val-de-Marne, runs a conventional linear sorter. The new Lyon machine does more in half the footprint: 870 sqm, handling 6,500 parcels an hour. It combines mechanical sorting with AI-equipped cameras, which Gofo credits with a 50% overall efficiency gain and the ability to automate sorting for more than 90% of parcel types.

#### By Back End News

 Aug 1, 2026 

foodpanda Philippines has expanded its pandamart dark-store network to 23 fulfillment hubs nationwide, increasing its logistics infrastructure to support faster online grocery deliveries and localized inventory management.

The latest facilities in Calamba, Laguna, and Caloocan City bring the network to 23 dedicated fulfillment hubs across Luzon, Visayas, and Mindanao. Unlike traditional supermarkets, pandamart locations are designed exclusively for online orders, allowing groceries and household items to be picked, packed, and dispatched directly to customers.

The company said the expanded network supports average delivery times of 25-35 minutes by making its fulfillment hubs closer to residential communities.
